items.title: ISO members send net-zero draft back for revisions
items.summary: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) is reviewing suggested changes to its corporate net-zero standard after a vote on the first draft fell short of the approval threshold.

items.title: How FedEx’s CSO engineers sustainability into long-term strategy
items.summary: FedEx has significantly expanded its purchases of unblended sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) with contracts to buy more than 20 million gallons for use at five major U.S. airports in California, Florida, New Jersey, New York and Texas through 2027.

items.title: ISO net-zero standard stalls following member feedback
items.summary: After attracting nearly 5,000 comments, members have sent the International Organization for Standardization's (ISO's) proposed standard back for revisions.

items.title: TODAY: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: Tomorrow, edie is holding a new webinar exploring how organisations can turn circular economy commitments into practical, measurable action across the business value chain.

items.title: Defra’s sustainable farming application runs dry in just six hours
items.summary: Access to more than £230m in government-led, sustainable farming funding was available for just six hours before it closed, with future funding streams not available until next year.

items.title: New Look, M&S, Sainsbury’s and Oxfam join forces to scale textile recycling
items.summary: The organisations have partnered with textile recycling firm Circle-8 to launch a new initiative that aims to accelerate circular fashion solutions.

items.title: Report: World not on track to meet 2030 ocean protection goal
items.summary: New research has found that existing government commitments globally are set to protect and conserve almost 30% of the world’s land by 2030; however, progress on ocean protection is severely lagging.

items.title: In practice: Sustainability supplier engagement schemes that work
items.summary: With businesses struggling to communicate sustainability endeavours transparently and dealing with short-term budget constraints, edie’s new ‘in practice’ series explores how some organisations are trialling and installing innovative projects to deliver climate action.

items.title: Beyond compliance: Turning climate risk insights into practical adaptation
items.summary: Event Date: 19/11/2026 | 1:00 pm UK | 8:00 am US East Coast ET | 5:00 am US West Coast PT | 2:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST This webinar will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: What does a revised ISO 14001 mean for sustainability professionals?
items.summary: On 29 September, edie is hosting a webinar in partnership with BSI to explore changes to the ISO 14001 standard addressing environmental management.
